releases.displayName: Quality of Life Update - Out Now!

items.text: Attention, shoppers! We're releasing our free Quality of Life Update today, full of features to make your time with Discounty as smooth as possible:
Quality of Life: Tear down posters, hide your scanner guide, improved shopping list UI, and much more!
Accessibility Settings: Change dialogue font size, instant-appearing dialogue, autoplay dialogue, motion sickness mode, and more!
Appeal Rework: Improved how appeal affects customers and increased appeal cap.
C.A.R. Rebalance: Customer reviews are fairer, and customers have more visual indicators when they're losing patience.
Dialogue System Improvements: Unique character dialogues now only occur once per playthrough, and all dialogues have been thoroughly reviewed so they only occur at appropriate moments in the story.
"Stress Free" Mode: Added setting to turn off customer patience if you prefer to play without pressure and want cozy vibes only!
Download the update now to try it out! Click here for the complete changelog:
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2274620/view/643581785571066454"]
This update adds some of the most-requested features while addressing common complaints from our community, including some very important accessibility options.

There's also many things you won't see. We've been hard at work improving some of the game's underlying systems. As you may know, Discounty is our studio's first game, and we learned quite a lot about game development while making it. However, we didn't have any time to implement most of these lessons…until now! Long story short, these "invisible" changes will make working on any future updates a lot more efficient, and with less chance of breaking what's already here. So even though it's not as exciting to talk about, just know it's a sign of more exciting things to come in the future!

We've made a few changes to make life in Blomkest a little bit easier. Now you can tear down posters after placing them, and hovering over a poster shows you a tooltip with the poster's effect and the number of days it has left. In the store, we've greatly improved the shopping list UI. It's also possible to hide the cash register and scanner guides, so you can more easily keep an eye on your store.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43640831/e4b0edab510c2714e3fcd18471431e1990a74d79.gif"]

There are now settings to change the size of the dialogue font, as well as having it play automatically and appear instantly! We've added a motion sickness mode that disables the scrolling bus in the main menu and also disables UI animations. You can also unlock the scanner from the beginning, access additional visual options, and more.

We've completely reworked how appeal works, but in short: appealing shelves and boosters work more predictably and are a more worthwhile investment. Previously, in some layouts, customers would almost always go to shelves with the highest appeal rating, even when other appealing shelves were nearby. Now even lower-appeal shelves can also tempt customers, while higher-appeal shelves are nearly irresistible. (We've also increased the appeal cap from 5 to 10, and customers can make more impulse purchases overall.) Invest in appeal – it'll be worth it!

Previously, it was sometimes unclear why customers became impatient and left negative C.A.R. reviews, even when you'd done everything "right." Now, if you are attentive to all of your tasks, customers are more likely to leave positive reviews – but the inverse is also true, so don't slack off! We've also added visual indicators to show when customers' patience is draining, so you can more easily identify issues:

But what if you don't want to deal with impatient customers at all? We know there are a lot of players who prefer a purely "cozy" experience, so we've added a setting to turn off customer impatience entirely. If you just want to relax – or are traumatized by having worked in retail IRL – this setting might be for you!
If you haven't yet, please take a moment to leave a review on Steam! Your feedback has been invaluable as we continue improving the game, and every review helps us reach new players.
Let us know what you think about the update, and until next time,
xoxo
Crinkle Cut Games

Go to your Steam library and find Discounty

Some people in Blomkest have deep pockets...and others deep secrets. Discover new ways to spend your hard-earned shills once the main story is finished, embark on a new questline, and uncover who's been pulling threads behind the scenes...
This update will give you some new things to do once you've reached the ending, so read on to learn what's in store (no pun intended), and how you can try it out today!

You need more space and can't expand outward...so what about straight down? This update adds a new questline that sees you expanding Discounty once again. But as you've no doubt learned, nothing in Blomkest comes easy...and there might be some other people in town who take an unexpected interest in your new basement project.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43640831/c5ff82199466d691c0d3f0fa12e0726000a65fef.png"]Nothing to see here.
Don't let your Discounty Rewards Points go to waste! We're adding a few new items to the Rewards Shop, including a new post-game category with some cool new ways to boost your efficiency and profits!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43640831/4d715e72a9fe738277fd4c96ff83934fdf2a495c.png"]

Solruna has been experimenting with extracting the essences of color, and believes a new coat of colored paint might be just the thing to purge the negative energies Discounty brought to town. In a new quest, you will learn how to transmute items from your store into new colors for the shop exterior. For a price, of course.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43640831/3ba64a5e8667d94c6933641aae31d98fdde3b8c5.gif"]

We're also throwing in a bunch of quality of life improvements and bug fixes! Some highlights include the ability to swap back to the cash register after upgrading the scanner, improvements to Chester's behavior, clarifying certain quests, and much more!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43640831/a190112519a246a6b4b429d45f4abcd018a1df90.png"]
Sound exciting? Well, good news: you can try it out right now! We've added a new Steam branch that will allow you to test updates so you can let us know what you think before it goes out to everyone!
We highly recommend backing up your saves before playing the public beta branch! To do so, back up the files in the following folder: %USERPROFILE%/AppData/LocalLow/Crinkle Cut Games/Discounty.
Go to your Steam library and find Discounty
Right click the game and click "Properties"
In the Properties window, go to the Beta tab, and select the "publicbeta" branch from the drop-down menu.

For now, the beta is only available in English. However, we will be adding all the other languages soon. To get notified of updates, watch our news page for patch notes, or join our Discord and choose the Public Beta role for pings! This Discord is also the best place to give feedback about the beta.
And remember to back up your saves!
Need help giving gifts to rats, infusing apples, or figuring out the most profitable items?

Learn more — or help write a guide — in our brand new Wiki, hosted by wiki.gg! We've been working on this with a few community members over the last few days. Since we expect Discounty will continue to grow for a long time, we want to build this up and make it the ultimate resource for all things Discounty.
But we need YOUR help: check out the Official Discounty Wiki now!
